name: cards-demo-1
title: Hover Overlay Card
description: A tall photo card with a bold title and short paragraph pinned to the bottom. Hovering swaps the still fern backdrop for a muted moving clip and adds a dark scrim behind the words.
use: A feature tile should hint at motion only on hover while keeping its copy readable.
avoid: Both media files are hardcoded remote URLs, and touch devices never see the hover swap.
a11y: Background media is CSS-only with no alt, and the hover swap is unreachable by keyboard or touch. (keyboard: no, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A tall portrait card with rounded corners and a dark full-bleed photo, white bold heading "Background Overlays" and a small white paragraph pinned to the bottom left. At rest the photo is a close-up of fern fronds.
behaves: Hovering replaces the still fern image with a looping clip of a person by a window and lays a dark scrim over it, while the text stays fixed. Leaving returns the fern photo and lifts the scrim.
customise: Nothing is exposed; the heading, paragraph and both media URLs must be edited directly in the file.
weight: light: One card with a background swap and an overlay scrim; the clip only loads on hover.
